stimulus.body: 材料背景：An architect's brief uses the idiom 马到成功 (ma dao cheng gong). 「Immediate success upon arrival.」 The idiom means immediate success upon arrival. The brief uses it to express hope for a project's quick completion. 下面是一则简短材料，用来考查这一用法的理解。材料后给出四个选项，只有一个选项与材料本身所提供的信息相符。

questions.stem: 以“Match an idiom to its meaning / Immediate success. / Proverbs and idioms”为依据核对材料，哪项结论成立？.
questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: 马到成功 means immediate success. On that basis "Immediate success upon arrival" is the supported choice. Option C ("Travel by horse") fails because it confuses idiom with transport; Option B ("Horse racing") fails because it reads literally only; Option D ("Agricultural success") fails because it confuses idiom with farming.

stimulus.body: 下面是一则简短材料，用来考查这一用法的理解。「虽然...但是 (although...but) fits contrast.」 材料后给出四个选项，只有一个选项与材料本身所提供的信息相符。

questions.stem: 本题的关键提示是“Choose a contrast connective / Contrast connective. / Linking sentences”。哪一项与材料一致？.

options.text: 不仅...而且 (not only...but also) fits addition

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: to pick a different logical relation. On that basis "虽然...但是 (although...but) fits contrast" is the supported choice. Option A ("因为...所以 (because...so) fits cause") fails because it confuses contrast with cause; Option B ("如果...就 (if...then) fits condition") fails because it confuses contrast with condition; Option D ("不仅...而且 (not only...but also) fits addition") fails because it confuses contrast with addition.

questions.stem: 结合提示“Choose a formal translation / Formal and appropriate. / Translation and register”，哪一项真正得到材料的支持？.

options.text: Yes, it is formal and appropriate

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: 请提交图纸 is formal and appropriate. On that basis "Yes, it is formal and appropriate" is the supported choice. Option A ("No, it changes the meaning") fails because it overstates the error; Option B ("No, it is too casual") fails because it misclassifies register; Option C ("No, it is too long") fails because it confuses length with register.

stimulus.body: 材料背景：An architect's brief contains a paragraph: 「Ventilation ensures health.」 'Ventilation ensures health. Windows provide airflow. Fans circulate air. Thus ventilation design is key.' The brief asks for the topic sentence. 下面是一则简短材料，用来考查这一用法的理解。材料中写道：「s brief contains a paragraph」。材料后给出四个选项，只有一个选项与材料本身所提供的信息相符。

questions.stem: 结合提示“Main idea first.”，哪一项真正得到材料的支持？.

options.misconception: confuses a supporting detail with the topic
confuses a supporting detail with the topic
confuses a conclusion with the topic

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: the first sentence states the main idea. On that basis "Ventilation ensures health" is the supported choice. Option A ("Fans circulate air") fails because it confuses a supporting detail with the topic; Option B ("Windows provide airflow") fails because it confuses a supporting detail with the topic; Option D ("Thus ventilation design is key") fails because it confuses a conclusion with the topic.
